name: ipatool
description: Command-line tool that allows searching and downloading app packages (known as ipa files) for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS from the App Store.
one_liner: A command-line tool for searching and downloading iOS app files directly from the App Store.
buyer: A mobile QA engineer at a company that needs to test against older versions of their own or competitor apps.
business_use_cases: A QA team downloads a previous version of their own app to reproduce a bug reported against that release.
A security researcher pulls down an app binary to analyze it for vulnerabilities.
An enterprise IT team archives specific versions of internal apps for compliance.

money_ideas.idea: Fold it into a broader mobile QA/security consulting offering rather than selling it standalone.

steal_this: This is a developer utility, not a standalone business. Useful as a component of a QA or security consultancy, not a product on its own.
